rules.hyperparameters: Copied from the corresponding DepMap whole-lineage outer fold
rules.truth: Sanger loss standardized with non-target paired Sanger moments
rules.prediction: Direct Broad expression prediction standardized with paired Broad moments
rules.test_isolation: Sanger labels were used only after all hyperparameters were fixed

limitations: Cross-platform z calibration is descriptive and does not make BAGEL and Chronos biologically identical.
The 66-model cohort is availability-selected and contains too few ccRCC models for subtype claims.
This benchmark cannot validate patient functional dependency.
Pleura and Prostate each lacked a >=20-model DepMap outer lineage and were excluded rather than borrowing another lineage's hyperparameters.
